x: • Of the favourites: Coleman (South Africa) was 4th, Heino (Finland) 11th, Côte (Canada) 17th, Vogel (USA) 14th, Kyriakidis (Greece) 18th, Kelley (USA) 21st, Yun Bok Suh (Korea) 27th.

Andy Coleman, of Enfield, jumped with 600 to go and was followed by an attentive Newham man in the form of Steve Hepples. Stephen Sharp (another who had returned recently from warm weather training in Portugal) sprinted to cover and passed Hepples but failed to catch Coleman.
